config.description: Hybrid E5/TF-IDF search plus deterministic routing of table/figure labels explicitly present in the user question; model selects at most two indexed regions and receives 150 DPI crops.
config.selection_policy: Choose on complete dev pass rate and group failures; use latency and cost as tie-breaks. A readiness target of 24/26 does not substitute for independent test.

note: Candidate search is text/caption-only; no gold is supplied to the model.
